$comment: First steps (GDD §6.1 v1.64): the opening square's cards, one at a time, each pointing at what it's about (`at`: a CSS selector the card rings; none: the world itself). Shown once a game slot after Ready; the menu's First steps shows them again. Plan for the services' first-open cards: docs/first-steps-plan.md. `once`: the first-open cards (docs/first-steps-plan.md §3), one card the first time a window opens in a slot.

steps.title: Walking
steps.text: Put a thumb down anywhere and drag: a stick comes up under it and your hero walks. Tap the ground to walk there, or a door, a person or a chest to go and use it. Pinch with two fingers to look closer or further.

steps.title: Your hero
steps.text: This is you, with your health under you. Tap it for your windows: Gear (what you wear, and the bag), Stats (the points each level brings, and what you were born with) and Skills (a new one every three levels; four go into a fight). Companions you hire get a card of their own beside yours.

steps.title: The compass
steps.text: Tap it and pick a place: the square's services, the land's dungeons, the quest you're following. Your hero walks there by themselves. Drag or tap the ground to stop.

steps.title: The Journal
steps.text: Every errand you've taken, its steps and who to go back to. The one you're following shows under it, and the compass knows the way.

steps.title: The map
steps.text: Out of the square, the minimap at the top right is the map: tap it for this land and the World round it, where the dungeons are, a tap on open ground to walk there, and the Guild's coach between the towns you've walked to.

steps.title: The menu
steps.text: Pause, your game slots, sound, graphics and brightness, and these first steps again. The game keeps itself as you go: nothing to save by hand.

steps.title: The square
steps.text: While you stand in a town's square its services are a tap away: the tavern for companions and the board, the inn to rest, the shop, the smith and the temple.

steps.title: Your first errand
steps.text: Maudry Fenn keeps the Tired Mule, here on the square, and she has work for someone new. A gold mark hangs over anyone with work for you. Walk up to her and tap her.

once.title: The shop
once.text: Plain arms and armour at your level, new every dawn: buy for anyone in your company. Sell what you carry, and buy it back if you change your mind. A Homeward Scroll is always on the shelf; it takes you home from a dungeon.

once.title: The smith
once.text: The forge makes what you wear better. Upgrade a piece a step at a time to +5, for gold and cinders (wood and stone from +3). Cinders come from salvaging gear you won't use.

once.title: The tavern
once.text: The Lantern Guild's room. Most come to hire: sellswords who fight beside you, new faces every dawn. The quest board, the coach and the rumours are the other rows.

once.title: Sellswords
once.text: Two slots beside you; more wait on the bench. A sellsword costs a fee to sign and a wage every dawn, wherever you are. Unpaid, their perks go dark until you settle. Paid while they fight with you, they grow loyal, and a Lantern or a Beacon shows a perk it kept back.

once.title: The inn
once.text: Rest to be whole again; it lifts Weakened. Companions you aren't taking wait here on the bench at half wages, and can be sent on the road for XP and gold while you're away.

once.title: The temple
once.text: The Grey Sisters raise companions who were slain: free once a day while you're level 5 or under, for gold after. Spending your attribute points again, or a new look, is here too.

once.title: The board
once.text: Small jobs for this land: hold a room so many waves, open chests, put down elites, reach a floor. Take one and it goes in your Journal; bring it back to a board for the pay. Three at a time; new jobs go up at dawn and dusk.

once.title: The coach
once.text: The Guild's coach runs between towns you've walked to, ten gold a day of road. Pick a town on the map and you're there; it leaves from a square.

once.title: The bag
once.text: What the company carries, and what each of you wears. Tap a piece for its card: wear it, give it to someone, salvage it. A green number is what gear adds; the border's colour and glow are its rarity.

once.title: Skills
once.text: A new skill every three levels, a passive every ninth; some wait on your class's trial. A point every second level raises a rank. Four skills go into a fight, passives always: pick them here, and they're used when the fight wants them.

once.title: A dungeon's room
once.text: The room is the fight: foes come in waves while you stay in it, each a little tougher. Walk out through a doorway and it's over, the room as it was. The stairs go down to harder floors.

once.title: Fallen
once.text: Downed, you get up when the wave falls. A companion Downed twice in one room, or left Downed when you walk out, is slain: a ghost until a temple raises them. If the whole company goes down, you wake at the temple, Weakened a while, a quarter of your gold gone.
